items.name: crypto-arbitrage-strategy
items.description: Delta-neutral ETH carry strategy collecting perpetual futures funding rates while hedging price risk. Python backtest on real Bybit data (2021–2026) returned +$18,442 on $10,000 capital (35.2% annualised, 13% max drawdown). Five verified Solidity contracts on Sepolia with Chainlink oracle and live Vercel frontend. MetaMask integration included.
